他看了看外面的天色，时间还早。天边刚泛起一点鱼肚白，离天亮还有一个多小时。

意念一动，进了空间。

空间里大毛它们五个还围在那八个人旁边，一动不动地盯着。看见王建新进来，大毛摇了摇尾巴，但没离开岗位。那八个人还躺在地上，昏睡得跟死猪一样，姿势都没变过。

王建新蹲下来，看着这八个人，心里琢磨着刚才那个“神识针刺”的实验。那人惨叫了一声，抽搐了一下，但没死。是力度不够，还是方法不对？他决定再试试。

这次他用神识形成一把锤子——在脑海里想象成锤子的形状。他随便挑了一个人，瞄准他的脑海，猛地砸了过去。

那人“啊”了一声，声音不大，像是从嗓子眼里挤出来的。身体剧烈抽搐了几下，腿蹬了两下，然后不动了，眼睛半睁着，瞳孔散了。

王建新用神识扫了一下，脑子里的组织被震得稀烂，像一锅豆腐渣。

他惊讶了一下，看来神识可以杀人。而且杀得很干净，外面看不出伤口，里面已经烂了。

然后又用神识变成一根粗一点的针，比针灸针粗多了，像织毛衣的签子。他朝着一人刺去，目标还是脑子。

那人“啊”的大叫一声，声音在空间里回荡，吓得大毛它们都竖起了耳朵。那人猛地坐起来，双手抱住头，狠狠地揪着自己的头发，他的眼睛瞪得溜圆，眼珠子都快爆出来了，嘴里发出野兽一样的嚎叫。

王建新看见其他几人有醒的迹象——有的皱了皱眉，有的翻了个身，有的嘴里嘟囔了一句。他赶紧一人补了一下安眠穴，让他们继续昏迷着。

那个抱着头嚎叫的人还在叫，王建新皱了皱眉，一个手刀劈在他脖子上，把他打晕了。

然后他又把灵气当做一个小炮仗似的，凝聚成一小团，打入另一人的脑袋里。灵气团像一颗种子，埋进脑子里，他意念一动——“砰”。

灵气突然炸开，声音不大，闷闷的，像是远处放了个炮仗。王建新用神识扫过，这个人脑子被炸成一团浆糊，直接抽搐了两下便死去，连叫都没叫出来。

看来用神识和灵力是可以杀人的。也就是说，他方圆五十米内，随时可以想要谁的命就要谁的命。不用动手，不用动刀，一个念头的事。

这可太厉害了。神不知鬼不觉就能要一个人的命，这难道就是修仙者的手段吗？

王建新蹲在那里，看着地上两具尸体，沉默了好一会儿。以前他杀人，用的是枪，一枪一个，干脆利落。现在不用枪了，用脑子想想就能杀人，这感觉不太真实。

He looked at the sky outside and saw that it was still early.The sky just turned a little white, and there was still more than an hour before dawn.

With a thought, he entered the space.

In the space, the five of them, Da Mao, were still gathered around the eight people, staring motionlessly.Seeing Wang Jianxin come in, Da Mao wagged his tail, but did not leave his post.The eight people were still lying on the ground, as sleepy as dead pigs, and their postures had not changed.

Wang Jianxin squatted down and looked at the eight people, thinking about the "spiritual acupuncture" experiment just now.The man screamed and twitched, but he was not dead.Is it not strong enough, or is the method wrong?He decided to try again.

This time he used his consciousness to form a hammer - imagining the shape of a hammer in his mind.He picked someone at random, aimed at his mind, and smashed it.

The man said "Ah", the sound was not loud, as if it was squeezed out of his throat.His body twitched violently a few times, his legs kicked twice, and then stopped moving. His eyes were half-opened, and his pupils were dilated.

Wang Jianxin scanned it with his spiritual consciousness, and the tissue in his brain was shattered to pieces, like a pot of tofu dregs.

He was surprised. It seemed that spiritual consciousness could kill people.And it was killed very cleanly. There were no wounds visible on the outside, but it was already rotten on the inside.

Then he used his consciousness to turn it into a thicker needle, much thicker than an acupuncture needle, like a knitting stick.He stabbed at one person, and the target was his brain.

The man yelled "Ah", and the sound echoed in the space, so scared that Da Mao and the others all pricked up their ears.The man sat up suddenly, put his head in his hands, and pulled his hair fiercely. His eyes were so wide that they almost burst out, and he howled like a wild beast.

Wang Jianxin saw signs that several other people were awake - some frowned, some turned over, and some muttered something.He quickly replenished the sleeping holes one by one, allowing them to remain unconscious.

The man holding his head and howling was still shouting. Wang Jianxin frowned and struck him on the neck with a knife, knocking him unconscious.

Then he used the spiritual energy like a small firecracker, condensed it into a small ball, and fired it into the other person's head.The spiritual energy ball was like a seed, buried in his brain, and he thought - "Bang".

The spiritual energy suddenly exploded, the sound was not loud and muffled, as if a firecracker was set off in the distance.Wang Jianxin scanned it with his spiritual consciousness. The man's brain was blown into a ball of paste. He twitched twice and died without even screaming.

It seems that one can kill people using spiritual consciousness and spiritual power.In other words, within a radius of fifty meters, he can kill anyone he wants at any time.No need to use hands, no need to use a knife, just a thought.

This is amazing.One can kill a person without anyone noticing. Is this the method used by cultivators of immortality?

Wang Jianxin squatted there, looking at the two corpses on the ground, and was silent for a long time.In the past, he used guns to kill people, one at a time, clean and crisp.Now that we don’t need guns, we can kill people just by thinking about it. It doesn’t feel real.
